title: Sweep the previous day's high at the open → it usually keeps going

hero.caption: Two opens tested — the **18:00 ET re-open** and the **02:00 London open**. When the 18:00 open takes out the previous day's high in the first 3 minutes, price keeps going 77% of the time. The London open runs even more.

chart.label: Continuation after a first-3-minute sweep — by open
chart.sub: Price pushes past the swept level instead of trading back through it
chart.note: London sweeps continue the most (82%) but also snap back the most (52% reversal) — not set-and-forget.

useIt: At both the 18:00 re-open and the 02:00 London open, a first-3-minute sweep of the previous day's high usually continues. London runs even harder but also reverses more often — manage it, the continuation isn't clean.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested over 2024–2026 · check it yourself
